Holzbaurechner / Carport

Wood carport calculator

Posts, beams, rafters and knee braces for a freestanding wood carport with a low-slope roof, from a single carport to a wide double.

How the carport is built

Two rows of 6x6 posts carry a built-up beam on each side. The rafters run across the width, sit on both beams and overhang them by 12 in. Knee braces between posts and beams keep the frame from racking. If the width is too much for 2x12 rafters, the calculator adds a center beam with its own posts.

A single carport is usually 10 to 12 ft wide and 20 ft long, a double carport 20 to 24 ft wide. Plan at least 7 ft clear height for cars and 8 ft or more for pickups and SUVs with roof boxes.

How the sizes are chosen

Rafter and beam sizes come from the IRC deck span tables for 40 psf live load. That is more than a roof in a mild climate has to carry, so the sizes are conservative. Where the ground snow load is high, the carport has to be designed for it. Your building department can tell you the design snow load and wind speed for your address.

Roofing

Corrugated metal panels on 2x4 purlins are the cheapest and lightest roof. Shingles need plywood or OSB sheathing on the rafters and at least a 2:12 slope. Roofing is not part of the lumber list, but the calculator shows the roof area you need to cover.

Building the carport step by step

  1. Permit and setbacks: carports need a permit in most places and have to keep a distance from property lines.
  2. Footings: mark out the post positions, check the diagonals, dig below the frost line and pour footings with post bases.
  3. Posts and beams: stand and brace the posts, cut them to the same height with a laser or water level and set the beams in post caps.
  4. Knee braces: cut 45° braces from 4x4s and screw them to posts and beams.
  5. Rafters and roof: set the rafters on the beams with hurricane ties, then add purlins or sheathing and the roofing.

Frequently asked questions

How much lumber does a 12x20 carport need?
A 12 × 20 ft carport with 8 ft clear height needs six 6x6 posts, two triple 2x10 beams 20 ft long and eleven 2x10 rafters at 24 in. on center, plus knee braces. The lumber costs about $800 at late 2026 prices, with hardware and concrete about $1,350.
Do I need a permit for a carport?
In most cities and counties, yes. A carport is a structure with a roof, and many places count it toward lot coverage and setbacks. Some areas exempt small structures, but the limit is usually 120 to 200 sq ft, which is smaller than a carport.
How deep do carport posts need to be?
The footing has to go below the frost line, which ranges from about 12 in. in the South to 48 in. or more in the northern states. Enter the frost depth for your area and the calculator sizes the concrete.

Lumber sizes follow the span tables of the 2021 International Residential Code (IRC) and are planning values. They do not replace a permit review or an engineer. Decks, patio covers and carports usually need a building permit, so check with your local building department.
